summary: v3 removes the continuous pseudo-script and protects mapped geography, but its thirty dark double-outline capsules read as dashed routes, repeat unnaturally, and fail to establish mountain relief.
required_changes: Change only the thirty capsule-like crest fragments into short, irregular, tapered, low-contrast single-line terrain strokes while preserving topology, detached hatches, roads, cities, fields, and the local edit scope.
